pr_summary: Fix for BigDLLM initialization where optimize_model and use_cache flags were being incorrectly retrieved from kwargs instead of from bigdl_llm_kwargs, causing these settings to be lost during model initialization.
candidate_smoke_commands: python -c "from bigdl.llm.transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM; print('import successful')"
patch_file_cues: bigdl_llm.py: Lines 49-50 changed from kwargs.get() to self.bigdl_llm_kwargs.get() for use_cache and optimize_model flags
test_file_cues: test_optimize_model.py: Tests optimize_model parameter with various models (Llama, Bloom, ChatGLM2, Replit Code)
test_optimize.py: Tests optimize_model API with low_bit quantization
test_optimize_mistral.py: Tests optimize_model with Mistral model
platform_constraint_evidence: setup.py explicitly handles Linux platform with linux_binarys list and platform detection
CI workflows (PR_validation.yml) run on Linux runners
No Windows-only or macOS-only API usage in the touched file bigdl_llm.py
notes: The repository is a Python-based BigDL-LLM project for running LLMs on Intel XPU. The fix is in the benchmark harness module (bigdl_llm.py) which wraps lm_eval's AutoCausalLM. The bug causes use_cache and optimize_model flags to be lost because they were being retrieved from kwargs (which had already been popped) instead of from bigdl_llm_kwargs. Tests use pytest framework and require model paths set via environment variables. Python 3.9 is the tested version. No conda/poetry/uv detected - pure pip-based installation.
